source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1949, p. 4 ("Rural councils: four new members in Castlereagh")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Names re-checked on the cited page BNL19490519.1.4 with a fresh fetch of the INA OCR: all surnames present (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Castlereagh rural district, one member each. There was no contest in 1949. The News-Letter names the four new members and records that no nomination was received for the Castlereagh division, so the retiring member retained it. New member, in place of Mr. S. Boyd. Returned unopposed.
